name: fastspam
description: Finds real mail in your Fastmail Spam folder, and spam that got past it, on Cloudflare Workers

FASTMAIL_TOKEN.description: Fastmail API token for scanning (Settings → Privacy & Security → Manage API tokens → New API token): protocol JMAP, **Read-only access** on, **Email** scope only. It cannot change mail.

FASTMAIL_WRITE_TOKEN.description: Optional. A second Fastmail token (JMAP, Read-only access **off**, **Email** scope only; not Email submission), needed only for `NOTIFIER=fastmail` (the digest is created in your Inbox), `RESCUE_MAILBOX` or `QUARANTINE_MAILBOX`. Enter `unused` otherwise.

POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN.description: Postmark Server API token, used when `NOTIFIER` is `postmark`. Enter `unused` otherwise.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Digest sender address. Postmark: a confirmed sender signature. Cloudflare Email: an address on your Email Routing domain. Fastmail: any address you own (shown as the From).

EMAIL_TO.description: Digest recipient address(es), comma separated. Ignored by `NOTIFIER=fastmail`, which files the digest straight into your Inbox.

DRY_RUN.description: `true` only logs the digest (good for a first run); `false` sends it.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for the digest time and the dates in it, e.g. `Europe/London`.

DIGEST_DAYS.description: Which days the digest goes out, in `TIMEZONE`: `mon`, `mon,thu` or `daily`.

DIGEST_HOUR.description: The hour (0-23) the digest goes out, in `TIMEZONE`.

AI_MODEL.description: Decision model: `@cf/cloudflare/clef` (default, runs on the free Workers AI allocation), `@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash`, `google/gemini-decision-1` or `openai/decisions` (the last two need `AI_GATEWAY_ID` and AI Gateway credits).

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Optional AI Gateway name. Required for `google/gemini-decision-1` and `openai/decisions`. With Unified Billing, Clef calls through a gateway are paid from credits instead of the free allocation: leave this empty to keep Clef free.

FASTSPAM_STATE.description: KV namespace for fastspam's state (progress through Sent and Spam, finds waiting for the digest, the Sent-recipient index). A new one is created for you.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email binding, only used when `NOTIFIER` is `cloudflare`.
